feeds.title: {Not Quite} Susie Homemaker
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Shell. I'm a mom to two boys and I'm married to my high school sweetheart. We live in Vegas but you can often find us on the road. I believe that life is too short to take yourself too seriously, and I also believe in having fun. While you're here, I hope to make you smile and maybe even find something that can make your life a little more fun, too. Follow the blog for weekly ideas for delicious recipes, fun things to do, and ways to help you enjoy life to the fullest.

feeds.title: Home Cooking Memories
feeds.description: I'm Brandie and this is my blog. I'm married to David and we live in Las Vegas, NV with our 4 children. Here, I share creative & easy recipes that are making memories in my home but also share modern-day recipe keeping techniques and ideas so you can preserve your food & recipe memories.

feeds.title: Always Expect Moore
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Carolina. A Well-intentioned Mom who enjoys doing all kinds of crafting, and teaching others how to create! Here on my site, you'll find lots of step-by-step craft and sewing tutorials, as well as recipes and my general musings.

feeds.title: My Vegas Mommy
feeds.description: Welcome to MyVegasMommy! My name is Jackie Landy. I am dedicated to finding the best deals around to save you money! We specialize in posting deals, coupons, local events, and more all-around greater Las Vegas. Subscribe and get coupons, restaurant deals, retail, daily deals, giveaways, reviews, and more!

feeds.title: The Nomis Niche
feeds.description: Based in Las Vegas, The Nomis Niche is a collection of outfit inspiration, beauty tips, and adventures of motherhood. The Nomis Niche is the personal style and fashion blog created and run by Lindsey Simon.

feeds.title: Growing Up Gabel
feeds.description: My name is Camille Gabel and I am a wife, blogger, and mom to Ella and Miles. Growing Up Gabel is a family-fun lifestyle blog featuring delicious recipes, easy crafts, family travel, & real family life!

feeds.title: Geri's 2 Cents
feeds.description: Geri's 2 Cents is a site created to help busy overwhelmed women find balance and accountability by a Las Vegas native, a wife & mom.

feeds.title: The Pinning Mama
feeds.description: I'm Kimber. Mom of 3 and Chief Creativity Officer at The Pinning Mama. Here you will find Easy, home-cooked family meals with side, freezer, and leftover suggestions, Simple Craft & Silhouette Tutorials,Stress-free Activities for Kids. Subscribe to email updates for new recipes delivered to your inbox!

feeds.title: Mommie of 2
feeds.description: My name is Lisa, and I am the author of the blog Mommie of 2. I love blogging and sharing great products that I find with my readers. I am also a stay at home mom. I love to spend time with my kids! I also have two lovable cats. I enjoy music, cooking, baking, exercising, crafting, reading, and spending time outdoors. Follow to get the updates on family-friendly product reviews and giveaways.

feeds.title: Hula Hooping Mom
feeds.description: I'm Tara Perez. I am a full-time mother and a wife to a wonderful husband! We have two children still at home - our son who is 13 and our baby girl who is 11. I love fashion, traveling the USA, history, fishing, camping, good deals, going out with the family, exploring new things, and always looking for a good quality product! Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: MomsLifeboat
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Gina, mother of 4, living in Las Vegas, Nevada. Our mission is all about helping you stay afloat when life is overwhelming. Momslifeboat is a lifestyle blog for women sharing unique topics for daily struggles. Follow and learn tips on Saving Money, Easy Recipes, Budget DIY, Life Stories, and More.
